map.基于浏览器 Web Speech API，将文字朗读为语音，支持中英文、语速音调: Based on the browser Web Speech API, reads text aloud as speech, supporting Chinese and English with rate and pitch adjustment
map.视障辅助阅读：粘贴长文，选中文语音（zh），点击朗读，浏览器本地合成语音逐字播报: Accessibility reading for the visually impaired: paste long text, choose a Chinese voice (zh) and click to read; the browser synthesizes speech locally word by word, which pairs with screen readers for accessible reading, and the text is not uploaded to the server.
map.中英文切换：语言筛选切到英文，选择 en 语音，朗读 “Hello, how a: Chinese/English switching: set the language filter to English, choose an en voice and read “Hello, how are you today?”; rate and pitch are adjustable (0.5~2.0) to suit different listening preferences.
map.公共语音提示：用预制“请注意安全，慢行通过。”等提示语，调音量/语速生成候车厅、: Public audio prompts: use preset announcements like “Please be careful, walk slowly.” and adjust volume/rate to generate waiting-hall or corridor broadcast scripts for looping playback or export.
map.：默认文本“欢迎使用语音合成工具，在这里输入文字即可朗读。”（含标点共 23 字: : The default text “Welcome to the speech synthesis tool; type here to have it read aloud.” (23 characters including punctuation), with a Chinese voice, rate 1.0, pitch 1.0 and volume 1.0—after clicking read, the status shows “Reading… character N” and updates character progress in real time via onboundary; when done it shows “Reading complete”. Speech is synthesized locally by the browser's built-in engine, no internet needed.

map.部分浏览器需在用户手动点击“朗读”后才会发声（如 iOS Safari 的安全策: Some browsers only produce sound after a manual click on “read” (e.g. iOS Safari security policy). If the page says “this browser does not support the Web Speech API”, please use the latest Chrome / Edge / Safari instead.
